世界卫生组织环境噪声指南为何给夜间道路交通噪声设定比昼间更低的健康基准值,两个时段对应的损害终点有何本质差异?

Why does the WHO environmental noise guidance set a stricter health benchmark for nighttime road-traffic noise than for daytime, and how do the damage endpoints underlying the two periods fundamentally differ?

白天的证据链集中于烦恼度评分与血压升高等心血管反应,夜间则以睡眠结构破坏为核心:入睡延迟、微觉醒频发、深慢波睡眠占比下降,即使当事人自觉一夜安眠,唾液皮质醇与动态血压仍出现可测量的偏移。碎片化睡眠继而放大高血压和缺血性心脏病的风险,指南因此把夜间基准值压得更低。中国2022年施行的噪声污染防治法也据此收紧了夜间施工与机动车鸣笛条款。
Daytime evidence clusters around annoyance scores and cardiovascular responses such as elevated blood pressure, whereas the nighttime burden centers on degraded sleep architecture: delayed sleep onset, frequent micro-arousals, and reduced slow-wave sleep, with measurable shifts in salivary cortisol and ambulatory blood pressure even when sleepers recall an undisturbed night. Fragmented sleep then magnifies hypertension and ischemic heart disease risk, which is why the guidance lowers the night reference value. China's Noise Pollution Prevention and Control Law, in force since 2022, tightened provisions on nighttime construction and vehicle horns along the same reasoning.

#噪声污染 #睡眠健康

同等照度下,为什么高色温、蓝光占比高的LED路灯对夜间昆虫和迁徙鸟类的干扰往往远超暖色低色温灯具?

At identical illuminance, why do cool-white LEDs rich in shortwave blue disturb nocturnal insects and migrating birds far more than warm-colored, low-color-temperature fixtures do?

多数夜行性昆虫与鸟类的视觉受体对400至500纳米波段最敏感,而短波蓝光在大气中的散射距离更长,趋光聚集、迷航和昼夜节律紊乱都会随色温升高而放大。野外对比记录显示,换用2700K以下的暖白光源后灯具附近的昆虫捕获量显著回落。柏林等欧洲城市已据此把市政照明的色温上限收紧到3000K。
Visual receptors of most nocturnal insects and birds peak between 400 and 500 nanometers, and shortwave blue scatters farther through the atmosphere, so phototactic attraction, disorientation, and circadian disruption all scale up with color temperature. Comparative field counts show insect captures near lamps fall sharply once fixtures switch to warm white below 2700 K. European cities such as Berlin have since capped municipal street lighting at 3000 K on this basis.

#光污染 #LED照明

夜间迁徙的鸟类为什么容易被城市人工照明吸引而偏离原有迁徙路线?

Why are nocturnally migrating birds so easily drawn off their migratory routes by urban artificial lighting at night?

许多夜间迁徙鸟依靠星空方位与地磁线索定向,而白光LED等宽谱光源的蓝绿成分在大气中散射强烈,形成的天光掩盖了自然参照系。靠近强光源后鸟的瞳孔收缩、暗视敏度骤降,个体开始绕灯盘旋,体能耗竭并撞上建筑物。削减灯具上射光通并在迁徙高峰调暗照明,已被证明能大幅减少这类致扰与死亡。
Many night migrants steer by stellar cues and the geomagnetic field, but the blue-green component of broad-spectrum white LEDs scatters strongly in air, producing skyglow that masks those natural references. Close to a bright source a bird's pupils constrict and scotopic sensitivity collapses, so individuals circle the light until exhausted and strike buildings. Trimming upward light flux and dimming installations during migration peaks has been shown to cut both disturbance and mortality sharply.
